about_data: Forecasts come from Open-Meteo, which combines the models of national weather services. They update every hour.
about_languages: SkySense is available in English, German, Slovak, Hungarian and Spanish. The translations are machine-assisted and still being reviewed.
about_what: SkySense answers the questions you actually have about the weather, and says how sure it is.
add_to_calendar: Add the good times to your calendar

feature_activities: The best time today and in the next 10 days for a run, a ride, a walk, a hike, a picnic, laundry outside, stargazing or golden hour photos, why each score is what it is, and the good times as a calendar file.
feature_air: Air quality and pollen, shown only when they matter.
feature_answers: Plain answers first: a sentence about the next 24 hours, what to wear, whether you need an umbrella, when it gets dark and how windy it is.
feature_comfort: A setting for people who get cold or warm easily, which moves the ideal temperatures for activities.
feature_confidence: How sure the forecast is: the likely range from 51 runs of the ECMWF model, marks on uncertain days, and five weather models side by side.
feature_normal: How today compares with the years 1991 to 2020, what this date was like in each of the last ten years, how long it has been dry, and the past year's records month by month.
feature_offline: Installs as an app, and shows places you opened before when you are offline.
feature_places: Places you can save, rename and reorder, a "My location" entry that finds you again when opened, two places compared day by day, a search in your language, and a link to share any place.
feature_radar: A rain radar for the last 2 hours and the model's rain for the next 3, on a map.
feature_settings: Your units, 12 or 24-hour time and five languages.
feature_sky: Tonight's moon, sunrise and sunset, the barometer and whether it is rising or falling, and a background sky that follows the time of day and the weather.

privacy_device: Saved places, your settings and your chosen activities are stored on this device only, in local storage and cookies. Clearing your browser data removes them.
privacy_hosting: SkySense runs on Vercel, which keeps short-lived request logs, including IP addresses, to operate the service. There is no analytics.
privacy_location: When you use your location or open a place, its coordinates are rounded to about 1 km and sent to our server, which asks Open-Meteo for the forecast. Open-Meteo only ever sees our server, not you. Our server keeps the forecast for a rounded place in memory for a few minutes, not linked to you.
privacy_radar: The rain radar map loads its images straight from RainViewer (radar) and CARTO (map), so they see your IP address and the area you look at.
privacy_summary: No accounts, no tracking, no ads.
